title: Verify the code signature of an application
summary: Check if an application on your Mac has a valid digital signature. This helps confirm the app hasn't been tampered with and is from a known developer.

steps.explain: Run the codesign tool to verify the signature of the specified application bundle.

placeholders.name: APP_PATH
placeholders.description: The full path to the .app bundle you want to check.

steps.expect: If the signature is valid, the command usually produces no output. If it fails, it will print an error message.
